name: Vocal Spectrum
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Pro-grade scrolling spectrogram tuned for the vocal range. See exactly where the harshness, the mud, the sibilance and the breath energy sit in real time. Reads as a colour heatmap with sub-band overlays for the four most-musically-important zones: 80-300 Hz mud, 1-2 kHz body, 2-5 kHz harshness, 5-10 kHz sibilance, 10 kHz+ breath/air.
